pageProps.content: ## Review There were several ways to get to The Gap Park, and we decided to take the ferry. When we arrived at the ferry dock, we heard that light snacks were allowed on board, so we grabbed some bread and coffee to go from a nearby cafe. The coffee came out quickly after ordering, and the bread was warmed up right away. The coffee was decent, and the bread was better than expected. ```adcard ``` It was convenient — just tap your transit card and board. It seemed like the ferry was just everyday public transport for locals, which I envied. Once on board, everyone headed up to the deck, so we tried to follow, but it was too crowded and the crew told us to come back down as the ferry was departing, so we came back down. Still, we found a spot with a great view and enjoyed our coffee and bread at a leisurely pace. ## Pictures
